component.name: Spaced Linux Welcome
component.summary: Install verified applications on a new Spaced Linux system

description.p: Spaced Linux Welcome opens on the first installed-system login, launches SpacedBazaar when requested, and installs suggested Flatpaks from Flathub and the signed Spaced GitHub application repository.

screenshot.caption: Suggested applications from Flathub and the signed Spaced GitHub repository

description.p: Suggests Voxa, a private voice assistant with local dictation and AI, in place of Voice2Text AI.
Replaces the "Opening SpacedBazaar" status once SpacedBazaar has launched, instead of leaving it on screen.
Removes the native Spaced Update action, reorganizes the suggested application list, and clarifies the SpacedBazaar action.
No longer installs the Spaced Update Flatpak alongside the copy Spaced Linux already ships, which left two identical Spaced Update entries in the menu.
Keeps Welcome open until application installation finishes and cleans up its installer process group on forced window destruction.
Adds direct Discord and Telegram community support links to setup and Help and Apps.
Installs SpacedBazaar on demand, configures its runtime source on fresh accounts, and opens Help and Apps directly from the desktop About shortcut.
Adds a clean, full-window AppStream screenshot, gives the SpacedBazaar shortcut its real market-stall icon, and uses the canonical silver Spaced emblem for the Welcome launcher.
Aligns the Suggested Applications heading with its application rows for a cleaner first-run layout.
Fixes every Flathub suggestion to use its published stable branch and moves SpacedBazaar into post-install delivery to keep the ISO lean.
Adds a Compiz desktop-effects quick start and clear first-snapshot and system-customization safety guidance.
Uses the renamed Cards With Cats application name and Flatpak ID.

Installs first-party applications by ID from the signed Spaced GitHub repository, adds a task-oriented Help & Apps page with direct SpacedBazaar links, adds version and homepage details, and fixes the native application icon.
